content.content: 1. Necessity: the prose leaves something only a machine-checkable artifact can settle — what counts as conforming. Fail if the artifact could be dropped without loss. 2. Fidelity, both directions: the artifact enforces exactly what the prose claims — no stricter, no looser, nothing smuggled in. Fail on divergence in either direction; name the diverging rule.
content.rationale: Redo is where the actions meet their state, selection, mechanism, order, and refusal; the gate forces them to answer to all five without re-deciding any.
